title: For a long stretch after Act I ended, status's 'The Gray:' summary line still read 'Six holds, six unrested griefs' while the paragraph directly above it (and the Hollows-rested counter) already reflected the real count of seven named holds (Thornwold, Fenmarch, Wardmoor, Iron Downs, Hollowbrook, Saltkerns, Emberfall). The game's opening pitch also promises only 'six holds' at the very start.
where: status output, 'The road' section, throughout Act 2
